headline: Corinth Canal: From a transit point to a global tourism and shipping destination! 34 million euro investment transforms the Canal
summary: A 34 million euro investment will transform the Corinth Canal under the management of AEDIK, including slope reinforcement and 12-month uninterrupted operation. Plans also include VIP services and digital modernisation.
why: The Corinth Canal is a key Greek shipping shortcut, so upgrades affect transit reliability and maritime traffic revenue.
